The committee voted unanimously to recommend that the city accept the two O'Maley Fish Sculptures on artistic merit, conditioned on the city having a risk assessment plan to inspect, maintain, and insure them. decisions: Recommended unanimously that the two O'Maley Fish Sculptures be accepted by the city on artistic merit, as long as there is a risk assessment plan by the city to inspect, maintain, and insure the sculptures.
